headline: Angola Oil Price Gap Reaches US$51 Per Barrel Above Budget
summary: Brent crude traded near US$112.40 on October 22, representing a gap of approximately US$51 above the US$61 benchmark in Angola's 2026 budget.
why: Angola is a major oil producer in sub-Saharan Africa, and deviations between actual commodity prices and budget baselines significantly impact government fiscal balances.

impacts.name: Angola
impacts.why: Higher oil prices relative to state budget projections increase government revenue inflows.
